note: Five stages, in play order. Each stage lists its trophies by id; the app renders the stage with live progress from the checklist.

stages.blurb: Play the story straight through, chapters 1 to 4 and the finale. Every mission trophy here is unmissable — just finish the missions. Do the two sampler activities when they show up so the later stages start warm.
stages.goal: Finish the story and open free roam with everything unlocked.
stages.name: Story run
stages.tip: Do not grind anything yet. Story missions pay out and unlock the map, the contacts and the activities the other stages need.

stages.blurb: Strangers are the heart of the mid-game: eight full strands, each ending in a finale mission, plus the partner moments and the one big story choice. Talk to every marked stranger you pass.
stages.goal: Clear 8 stranger strands, the partner trophies and the story choice.
stages.name: Strangers & partners
stages.tip: Stranger markers appear as you explore — sweep each district and clear its markers before moving on, so nothing is left behind.

stages.blurb: Slow down and fill the map: meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK tags, vehicle discoveries, every region, and the quiet secret moments on Ocean Beach and at the bowling alley.
stages.goal: 100% of regions, all meditation spots, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK tags.
stages.name: Explore & collect
stages.tip: Work district by district with the map open. Collectibles are fastest in one focused sweep each, not scattered across the whole game.

stages.blurb: The skill wall: 250 stunts, gold at every shooting range, 20 race wins, drone races, 50 challenges, and the five heist-style jobs. These take the longest — spread them across the stage, not in one sitting.
stages.goal: All skill, race and heist trophies, including the silver shooting-range gold.
stages.name: Skills & heists
stages.tip: Do the shooting range first: it teaches the gunplay the heists need, and its gold medals are the hardest single trophy in the set.

stages.blurb: Money does the last talking: launder $250,000 of marked bills, spend $100,000 across the shops, buy every garage, register ten vehicles — and the 100% gold and the platinum land with them.
stages.goal: Money trophies, 100% completion, and the platinum.
stages.name: Money & platinum
stages.tip: Keep laundering from stage 3 onward so the $250,000 is already banked by the time you reach this stage.
